name: productivity
description: A small set of general tools usable in any agent process: stand up a monitor outside the chat and launch long jobs fail-fast under it (watch), author a new skill that is portable, concise, in a generic voice, with a trigger-rich description (write-a-skill), and hand the conversation off to a new agent (handoff).

interface.shortDescription: General tools for any agent: watchdogs outside the chat, skill authoring, session handoffs.
interface.longDescription: A small set of general tools usable in any agent process: stand up a monitor outside the chat and launch long jobs fail-fast under it (watch), author a new skill that is portable, concise, in a generic voice, with a trigger-rich description (write-a-skill), and hand the conversation off to a new agent (handoff).
interface.defaultPrompt: Write a handoff for the next session.
